external_input: only existing plugin slot values/presence and timestamp history

formulas.H: estimated spell_haste time multiplier; H=1/(1+estimated_haste_fraction), derived/updated from plugin timestamp history; default prior is an explicit model assumption
formulas.MB_VB_recharge_s: 9*H unless observed A1 countdown/history supplies a better value; both actions use same observed readiness
formulas.TS_recharge_s_source: (12 if MID2_2pc else 15)*(H if tentacle_hasted_from_direct_fixed_mods else 1)*other_known_recharge_multipliers
formulas.TS_recharge_s_optional_estimate: 12*H is selectable only as an explicit empirical estimate if haste classification/multipliers are not established; never label it observed
formulas.usable_TS: A2_CHG>=1; unavailable if complete fresh A2_CHG==0; unknown if missing/conflicting
formulas.TS_full_recharge_s: 0 if charges==2; remaining_next_recharge if charges==1; remaining_next_recharge+estimated_TS_recharge_s if charges==0
formulas.VV_supply: crushing_void>0 OR void_volley>0; practical displayed surrogate is fresh A7 confirmed replacement with positive count
formulas.ordinary_VV_cast_consumption: crushing_void=max(0,crushing_void-1);void_volley=max(0,void_volley-1); do not use sum as guaranteed executable count
formulas.MB_VB_mode_practical: VB if chosen void_blast and model_rift_active; otherwise MB. model_rift_active uses D1 proxy plus plugin-derived history as estimated bridge
formulas.MB_VB_mode_exact_source: rift_tracking_up OR internal_channel_is_VTorrent activates VB and excludes MB; do not observe internal_channel_is_VTorrent, model ordinary rift implication instead
formulas.ordinary_Madness_cost: 55; free-proc branch disabled for current pinned no-Mind-Devourer configuration
formulas.MFI_candidate: disabled for current Voidweaver profile; ordinary Mind Flay remains filler
formulas.PI_haste_time_multiplier: H_without_PI/1.20 when fresh D3 confirms PI; do not apply twice if observed A1-based H already includes PI

void_volley.supply_surrogate: fresh confirmed replacement+count; hidden two-buff composition remains estimated

mind_flay_insanity.reason: current Voidweaver, no Archon Resonant Energy/MFI supply model

D1_RIFT_PROXY.default_policy: fresh D1 positive presence models active rift; absence models inactive unless same plugin history predicts ordinary rift grace; annotate estimated

A7_SUPPLY_PROXY.count_api_mapping: fixed 332/408 source bridge exists; actual game aggregation unverified
A7_SUPPLY_PROXY.default_policy: use supply boolean from complete fresh replacement/count; do not backsolve both buff stacks

TS_HASTE.optional_12H_model: explicit estimator policy, superseded by consistent A2 recharge histories

MB_PROC_CHARGES.source: Shadowy Insight can add MB supply and consumes its proc layer instead of normal cooldown update
MB_PROC_CHARGES.default_policy: trust fresh A1 readiness/countdown; do not infer every proc or count from base max1

ESTIMATED_CAST_EVENTS.policy: CD restart/charge decrement/DOT or BUFF appearance may update hidden history model with confidence; recommendation emission itself is not proof player executed it

fresh_unknown_policy.missing_or_stale_or_conflicting_slot: UNKNOWN observed; estimator may choose labeled hypothesis and retain confidence/risk

preferred_config_supersedes: model_config.json adds fixed PI20 percent source constant only
